assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original furniture storefront room hero, Habitat design study. Primary request: photograph a quiet, airy Indian contemporary living room, a low solid natural teak lounge chair with five broad vertical back slats, a simple angular frame and oatmeal linen seat cushion, paired with a low round natural teak side table. Pale limewashed walls, soft sandstone floor, a single large window and subtle woven rug, a plain ceramic vessel, small leafy branch. Furniture is the subject and must be fully visible; no people. Wide panoramic composition, eye-level 35mm lens, generous negative wall space, late morning natural light, warm ivory, honey teak, muted olive. Architectural editorial photography with believable grain and proportions. No type, brands, logos, watermarks, collage, UI or decorative signage. Original fictional products, no recognizable commercial furniture replicas. Output one landscape photograph.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: Habitat fictional catalog product photograph. Reference image: furniture identity and materials only. Create a clean studio product photograph of only the exact teak lounge chair from the reference photograph, keeping its broad six-slat angled back, thick oatmeal linen seat cushion, low angular solid teak frame, golden natural grain and unarmed silhouette. Entire chair visible, front three-quarter view, centered with generous margin on warm off-white seamless floor/background, soft natural studio light and grounded shadow. No table, room props, people, writing, labels, logos or watermark. Do not alter the chair design. Landscape 4:3 composition.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: Habitat fictional furniture catalog photograph. Reference image: round table identity and materials. Photograph only the exact round low teak side table from the reference: a thick round top, two broad intersecting slab supports with visible golden teak grain. Remove vessel, bowl and all props. Keep its design, natural honey teak finish and scale. Entire table visible centered with wide margins on a warm off-white seamless floor/background, soft studio daylight with a grounded shadow, front three-quarter view, landscape 4:3. No chair, room, people, text, watermark or branding.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Habitat furniture finish variant catalog photograph. Edit the reference photograph: change only the exposed teak wood finish to a deeper smoked teak brown, keeping the natural wood grain visible. Keep every chair dimension, shape, slat, leg, oatmeal cushion, fabric, viewpoint, lighting, shadow, seamless backdrop and composition unchanged. No new objects, writing, labels, logos or watermark.

notes: One coherent responsive HTML/CSS presentation; four image assets reused across 45 views.
Generated imagery is fictional and illustrative; dimensions/material facts come from fixtures, not measurement of photographs.
No Shopify or real merchant photography is used in theme scenes.
